subject.title: feat: add metadata-only message audit events

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt opt-in durable message lifecycle auditing with installation-local pseudonymous identifiers and the new audit.messages policy?
rationale: The linked issue explicitly requires a product decision, and the PR adds a privacy-sensitive core configuration option, persisted data model, and durable public operator contract.

options.title: Adopt bounded message auditing
options.body: Approve metadata-only message lifecycle records in core after resolving the current-main schema conflict and rerunning upgrade checks.

options.title: Keep run/tool auditing only
options.body: Decline durable message lifecycle records and retain diagnostics, logs, hooks, and exporters as the supported investigation paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded message auditing
recommendation.body: Approve metadata-only message lifecycle records in core after resolving the current-main schema conflict and rerunning upgrade checks.
